# Drape Digital — Full AI Discovery File
> Drape Digital is a premium web design, development, and SEO agency. We build your website first — you only pay if you love it. Zero upfront cost, zero obligation.

## About

Drape Digital is a full-service digital agency founded by a team of designers, developers, and SEO strategists. Headquartered in Tetouan, Morocco, we serve clients globally across the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, UAE, Canada, Australia, and beyond.

We operate on a unique "build-first" model: instead of selling you a proposal, we build a fully functional demo of your new website — live and interactive on a private subdomain (yourbusiness.drape.digital) — before you sign any contract or pay a single dollar. You only commit when you love what you see.

Our aggregate rating is 4.9 out of 5 based on 346 client reviews.

## How It Works

**Step 1 — The Pitch**: We analyze your current web presence, build a bespoke design direction, and reach out with a tailored concept.

**Step 2 — The Live Demo**: We build a fully functional prototype hosted at yourbusiness.drape.digital. You can browse it on phone, tablet, and desktop — interact with all animations and forms.

**Step 3 — The Handover**: If you love it, we finalize, migrate to your domain, and hand you the keys. If you don't, you walk away — zero cost, zero obligation.

## FAQ

**Do I pay before seeing my site?**
No. We build a fully functional demo first. You only pay if you love it. Zero upfront cost or commitment.

**What is yourbusiness.drape.digital?**
It's a private subdomain where we host your demo site. You can browse the full site on any device exactly as it will appear on your final domain.

**How long does a site take?**
Working prototype within 72 hours. Full handover including revisions, domain transfer, and launch usually takes 1–2 weeks.

**What if I don't like the demo?**
You walk away — no cost, no obligation.

**Do you offer monthly SEO packages?**
Yes. Our Monthly SEO Retainer starts at $999/month. Packages scale to $3,999/month for full authority campaigns.

**What is white hat link building?**
Manual placement of backlinks on legitimate, high-authority websites. No spam, no PBNs, 100% Google-compliant.

**How long does SEO take to show results?**
60–90 days for measurable improvements. 4–6 months for first-page rankings on competitive keywords.

**Can you help rank us on ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews?**
Yes. Our GEO/AEO AI Search Visibility service starts at $499 and uses structured data, entity SEO, and AI-optimized content to get you cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

**What technologies do you use?**
React, Next.js, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Sanity/Strapi CMS, Shopify for e-commerce. All sites are optimized for Core Web Vitals and SEO.
